p1cd_preserve: expectedRouteForAction derives exact literal Foundation route from opened definition UUID and operation kind
routeForAction requires byte equality between rendered route and derived route
prepareAttempt does not seal CSRF or request headers
performSealedAttempt re-reads current presentation authority and current CSRF immediately before send
readCurrentServerAuthority re-confirms exact validate/publish route facts
imported validation reconciliation also obtains transport authority only at the send boundary

constants_and_exact_keys: split validation-ticket exact keys from publication-ticket exact keys
publication ticket exact keys: contract, contract_version, project_id, definition_id, operation_id, operation_kind, expected_manifest_hash, request_body_sha256
publication operation_kind admits INITIAL or SUCCESSOR only
buildTicket: VALIDATE_DEFINITION builds the existing byte-replay-capable validation ticket
PUBLISH_INITIAL/PUBLISH_SUCCESSOR build the reduced publication recovery ticket only
publication ticket contains no route, method, body_utf8, if_match, content_type, csrf, cookie, credential, role or capability
retention: downloadTicket exports bytes but must not call retainTicket and must not unlock execute-sealed-attempt
exact-copy unlocks only when proof text equals sealedAttempt.ticketText byte-for-byte
bind ticket-file-proof + acknowledge-ticket-file to byte-exact saved-file re-import; any mismatch remains locked
cross-kind or malformed proof fails closed
publication_process_loss: add strict publication-ticket parser/importer bound to the opened definition
import creates only recovery identity for exact project_id + operation_id + expected publication kind/definition identity
import must never create or replace sealedAttempt and must never enable a publication POST
recoverPublication must accept the in-memory unresolved publication attempt or the imported GET-only recovery identity
post-loss recovery issues exactly the Foundation publication-operation GET and zero publication POST replay
validation_process_loss: verifyImportedValidationTicket remains strict HUMAN ticket only and VALIDATE_DEFINITION only
validation import may restore only explicit byte-identical FD05 replay
validation ticket must never activate publication recovery

handleKnownFailure: use a finite status/operation-compatible accepted-code map
reject unknown, malformed, control, bidi or overlong code values to a bounded generic state
404 is non-fingerprinting FOUNDATION_OBJECT_NOT_VISIBLE or binding bounded equivalent
manualRefresh_and_initialise: do not collapse authentication loss, presentation denial, not-visible object, transport/representation failure and claim-contract failure into one state
distinguish claim-contract failure from legitimate canRead=false presentation denial
render no exception text, detail prose or unchecked server token

binding_acceptance: exact-copy and byte-exact file re-import are the only retention proofs
publication response loss + tab/process loss + publication-ticket import + exact GET recovery is proven
publication POST count remains exactly one across process-loss recovery
validation lost-response replay stays byte-identical and explicit
no retry, timeout increase, assertion weakening, path growth, cdp_client.mjs change or target PR mutation

historical_provisional_oracle_only.warning: not repository-addressable; regenerate semantics from durable P1-C/P1-D source and authority, then persist the new candidate before expensive gates
